existing_rows_audit.detail: The Hong Kong office is real — Ubiquant Asset Management Co., Limited, SFC-licensed, incorporated 19 Apr 2021, One Pacific Place, Admiralty — but the firm's own careers portal (https://www.ubiquant.com/website/career -> https://app.mokahr.com/apply/ubiquantrecruit/37030) lists no Hong Kong role at all; all 20 live reqs are tagged 境内 (onshore) in Beijing/Shanghai/Shenzhen. HK listings exist only on eFinancialCareers HK, which is bot-blocked (405 / human-verification wall), so the req could not be read. The row's claim 'HK entity avoids Mandarin wall' is plausible for the offshore entity but is not evidenced by any posting I could load. The comp figure 'up to $300k (new grad AI/CS)' traces to press reporting on Ubiquant's 2021-22 AI new-grad packages at the mainland entity, not to any HK posting — it should not be attributed to Hong Kong.

A matching req is genuinely open: 「AI算法研究员」(AI Algorithm Researcher, AI部) at 中关村东路1号院清华科技园8号楼B座赛尔大厦26F, Haidian, Beijing — https://app.mokahr.com/apply/ubiquantrecruit/37030#/job/8f7eaed4-014d-411b-bb12-bca8e13d2184 — and it explicitly lists top-conference/journal papers and ACM-ICPC/NOI results as bonus criteria, which supports the row's 'papers examined' claim. Two corrections to the row, though: (a) Beijing is NOT in this pass's location scope (the brief lists Shanghai as the only in-scope mainland city) — the same req is also open in Shanghai, which is in scope, so the row should be re-pointed there; (b) the row's 'up to $300k + profit share' figure is 2021-22 press reporting, not a stated figure in any posting — the only comp-adjacent data in the ATS payload is an internal bonus band of 4-10 months of salary. The row's 'new-grad AI/CS track explicitly open to recent grads' framing also conflates this experienced-hire req with the separate 梧桐计划 campus programme, which is 应届生-gated and therefore a poor fit, not the candidate's 'strongest gate anywhere'.

notes:
METHOD: Ubiquant's own site (ubiquant.com) is a JS-rendered Chinese page behind a qualified-investor interstitial; its 招贤纳士 (careers) page at https://www.ubiquant.com/website/career links out to a MokaHR ATS under org 'ubiquantrecruit' — siteId 37030 (社会招聘 / experienced hire) and 37031 (校园招聘 / campus). Both boards are SPAs whose job-detail API returns AES-CBC-encrypted payloads; I recovered the full job descriptions by decrypting them with the per-response key the API ships alongside the ciphertext, so every 'verified-primary' row above reflects the actual posting text as of 2026-08-04, not a summary. The English toggle on ubiquant.com points at the same Chinese Moka board — there is no separate English careers site.

COVERAGE: 20 live reqs total across the two boards. In-scope by location: Shanghai only. Beijing (Haidian, Tsinghua Science Park) and Shenzhen (Futian, Ping An Finance Centre) are large Ubiquant offices but are outside this pass's location list; nearly every Shanghai req is cross-posted to Beijing and often Shenzhen, so applying in Shanghai is a matter of picking the city on the same req. Out-of-scope reqs I excluded: 财务核算经理 (finance manager), K8s运维工程师 (SRE/ops), 数据抓取工程师 (data scraping), all seven 实习生 internships on the campus board, and 【揽月计划】量化交易分析师 (a genuine Trader-track fresh-grad programme, but Beijing-only, so out of scope on location).

MANDARIN: every single posting is written in Chinese only, with no English version anywhere on either board, and all are tagged with the ATS custom field 職位區域類別 = 境内 ('onshore'). This is a Mandarin-first mainland employer. The one explicit language requirement I found on the experienced-hire board is on the Quantitative Risk Model Developer req — '强大的沟通能力（包括中英文工作能力）', i.e. strong communication including the ability to work in both Chinese and English; the Beijing-only 揽月计划 trader programme similarly asks for '中英文流利'. Neither is an English-tolerant exception; both assume working Mandarin. I found no English-tolerant onshore seat.

ONSHORE vs OFFSHORE: the mainland entity is 九坤投资（北京）有限公司 (Ubiquant Investment (Beijing) Co., Ltd.); the offshore entity is Ubiquant Asset Management Co., Limited, a wholly-owned HK subsidiary incorporated 19 April 2021, SFC-licensed, at One Pacific Place, Admiralty. The Moka careers portal serves the mainland entity only and cannot route an application to Hong Kong. Separately, UBIQUANT TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PTE. LTD. was registered in Singapore on 11 July 2025 (250 North Bridge Road #39-01, Raffles City Tower) — I found no Singapore job postings and no confirmation it is a staffed office rather than a shell, so Singapore is not listed as a confirmed in-scope office. No evidence of any Tokyo, UK or EU presence; press reporting from 2024 mentions US expansion plans only, which is out of scope.

BLOCKED PAGES: eFinancialCareers HK (the only source showing Hong Kong reqs) is behind bot protection — WebFetch returns HTTP 405 and direct curl hits a 'Human Verification' page — so the HK row is reported-secondary and its title, date and requirements are unverified. LinkedIn's Ubiquant jobs tab was not loadable either. The internal-referral Moka board (siteId 37032) is reachable via API but its public page 404s; it carried one additional Shanghai req (LLM pretraining data) which I have flagged accordingly.

COMPENSATION: no posting on either board states a salary or a range — Ubiquant has 薪资范围 (salary range) switched off in its ATS field-visibility config. The widely-repeated '$300k for AI/CS new grads' and '$1m for experienced hires' figures come from 2021-22 press coverage, not from any current posting, and I have therefore left comp_local empty on every row.
